_why: fixup-aq X1: the note's gain (data-gain) is the widest drawn row's own range, and that row says so ('range X mV sets the gain') with the same number; every trace fills most of its row
fixup-aq X2: choosing another span in the window picker refetches: the URL carries ?window=motif-<n>, the phrase and the axis change
fixup-aq X2: the deep link reproduces a window: span 2, padded 60 s each side, said in one phrase the axis agrees with
fixup-aq X2: the next-span arrow walks the channel's spans in time order and writes the same ?window=
fixup-aq X2: a ?window= naming a span that does not exist says so in words and shows the default, never a blank

fixup-aq X3 (integration fix: pinned to the 640 s window at 378.49 h, CH16_D2 propagation -41 s, instead of the channel's default window, which is its LATEST span and moves with every run the walk makes — on a window of only independent rows no bin carries the not-run rule): a plain window is classified detrended; each bin's tip carries the window rule from the bridge (detrended, no chance test), and each r carries the as-recorded reading beside it

fixup-aq X4 (integration fix: pinned to the window at 378.49 h where CH16_D2 sits at -41 s and CH15_D2 at -2 s; the default window is the channel's latest span and the walk's own runs move it — the full wave walk landed on #5230, every lag 0): lag-aligned slides each row by its detrended lag; at least one row carries a non-zero shift. If this fails on the real window, read the lag column: every lag still 0 after detrending would be a finding (simultaneous pickup), not a drawing fault
fixup-aq X3: an edge's window stays as recorded, so it still shows what the edge stores (fixup-w: CH5 +11.1 s, r 0.71, propagation)
fixup-aq X5: opened without a family, the greyed Classify card prints its reason under it
fixup-aq X6: the reference row's lock says why it is pinned and that the reference dropdown changes it

fixup-aq fix round: a ?t0=&t1= window with no edge context (no family= / grouping=) is detrended and called a window, not an edge window — the same window gives the same numbers whichever link opened it
ux-1019 (site-fixes item 5): the detrend control is raw · linear · cubic and reaches the read; ?detrend=cubic measures lag and r on the cubic-detrended window and the note says so
